example_sentences_in_bangla: সে চক্ষু লাল করে বকুনি দিচ্ছে।
রাগে তার চক্ষু লাল হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is seeing red and scolding everyone.
She turned red-eyed with anger at the news.
note: The idiom draws from the physical sign of bloodshot eyes due to intense anger, common in Bengali expressive language.
